This game is about the 2 best things mixing portal from value and shooters together also kinda fast paced! Guess what. This is the game for YOU! This game has so much to offer such as AK Pistol and Shotgun for weapons there is more but it’s paid. The maps they only have shooting range and lab.  But Wait. There’s even MORE! Guess what you know the portal gun you have? You can turn it into a fire mode that does a small explosion and guess what you can rocket jump around the map with it! I can’t explain everything because I only got to play for 30 minutes but this has to be the best gtag movement vr/shooter ever!
Its solid but please add Player customization like changing the eyes, colors, even the body as in adding parts you can add on your robot ! and add more guns in the future 😄

developer_response.body: That’s already on our roadmap! Stay tuned for upcoming updates. Thanks for the suggestion, we hadn’t considered eye customization or add-on parts before so it will happen!
